• This is because people prefer to **save when interest rates are high **and **spend or borrow when rates are low**.

• Money whose **value comes from a commodity **of which it is made is known as **commodity money**.

questions.question: In the periodic table, as one goes down the group, which property doesn't change?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Valency**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Valency

 
 
• **Valency **is the **combining power **of **an element**.
 
• **Elements **in the **same group **of the **periodic **table have the **same valency**.
 
• The **valency **of **an element **is related to **how many electrons **are **in the outer shell**.
 
• On **moving down a group**, the number of **valence electrons **remains the **same**.
 
• **All the elements **in a **group exhibit **the **same valency**.
 
• For example, **all the elements of group 1 **have a **valency equal to 1**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Metallic character

 
 
• **The metallic character **is the **tendency **of **an element **to **lose electrons **and form **positive ions **or **cations**.
 
• The metallic nature **increases moving down **the **group **because electron **shielding causes **the **atomic radius to increase**.
 
 
 
• **Atomic size**
 
 
• The **atomic radius **of a **chemical element **is a **measure of the size of its atom**, usually the mean or **typical distance **from the **center of the nucleus **to the **outermost isolated electron**. The **atomic size **of an atom **increases across the period **and **decreases down the group**.
 
 
 
• **Number of shells**
 
 
• This shell can contain a **maximum of two electrons**. The **second shell **can hold a **maximum of eight electrons**.

questions.question: If the difference between the exterior and the interior angles of a regular polygon is 60°, with an interior angle being greater than the corresponding exterior angle, then find the number of sides of the polygon.

Number of sides = (360)/(exterior space angle)

**Calculation:**

According to the question

⇒ I - E = 60º 

we know that I + E = 180º

On solving to we get,

⇒ 2I = 240º

⇒ I = 120º so E = 60º

Number of sides = (360)/(exterior space angle)=(360)/(60)=6

**The number of sides of the regular polygon is 6.**

questions.question: Find the LCM of 6, 72 and 120.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The number are 6, 72 and 120 

**Concept Used:**

LCM is the method of finding the smallest possible multiple of two or more numbers.

**Calculation:**

The factor of 6 = 2 x 3

​The factor of 72 = 2 x 2 x 2 x 3 x 3

​The factor of 120 = 2 x 2 x 2 x 3 x 5

LCM of 6,72 and 120 = 2 x 2 x 2 x 3 x 3 x 5 = 360

**Hence, The LCM of 6, 72 and 120 will be 360.**

⇒ Factor of 6 = 2 x 3

i.e. the number is a multiple of 480 and bigger than 1331 and less than 1728.

questions.question: The compound interest on Rs. 20,000 at 8% per annum is Rs. 3,328. The period in years is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The **Effective Rate** for 2 years at **8% per annum** = 8 + 8 + (8 × 8)/100 = **16.64%**.

**Compound Interest** = 16.64% of **₹20,000** = (16.64 ÷ 100) × 20,000 = **₹3,328**.

Since the calculated interest matches the given interest exactly, the **Time period** is **2 years**.

**∴ The correct answer is 2 years.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Principal (P)** = ₹20,000

**Compound Interest (CI)** = ₹3,328

**Rate (R)** = 8% p.a.

**Formula Used:**

**Amount (A)** = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ, where n is the **Time period**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2de0f1da5d15f534aaa32bcb3dcdebf594fe181d3dc69477f26b08fd38df68e.png] 

⇒ **Amount (A)** = **Principal** + **CI**

⇒ **A** = 20,000 + 3,328 = 23,328

⇒ 23,328 = 20,000 × (1 + 8 ÷ 100)ⁿ

⇒ 23,328 ÷ 20,000 = (108 ÷ 100)ⁿ

⇒ 1.1664 = (1.08)ⁿ

⇒ (1.08)² = (1.08)ⁿ

⇒ n = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2 years.**

**__Additional Information__**

Effective Rate of Interest

For two successive interest periods with rate r, the effective rate is Rₑff = r + r + (r × r) ÷ 100.

CI and SI Difference

The difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest for 2 years is D = P × (R ÷ 100)².

Rule of 72

To find the approximate time it takes for an investment to double at a fixed annual rate of interest, divide 72 by the rate: Time ≈ 72 ÷ Rate.

Length of two bridges be 600 m and 200 m respectively

Distance = Speed × Time

 Let the length of the bridge be LB₁,length of the 2nd bridge be LB₂

 Length of the train be LT

 LT = 80S - 600 ......................(1)

 Now, LB₂ = 200m , time = 40s

⇒ LB₂ + LT = S × 40............. .( Put the value of Length of the train from equation (1) 

⇒ (200 + 80S - 600 ) = 40S

⇒ 40S = 400 

⇒ S = 10 m/s.

Now, Length of the train =( 80S - 600) =( 80 × 10 - 600 ) = ( 800 - 600 ) = 200m

**Hence, Length of the train is 200m.**

Numbers in arithmetic progression 2,7,12,.......

⇒ aₙ = a + ( n -1) d

⇒ a₁₀ = 2 + ( 10 -1) × 5 

⇒ a₁₀ = 47

**Hence, 10th term is 47.**

questions.question: A is 6 years older than B. 10 years ago, B's age was three quarters of A's age. Find the present age (in years) of A.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **age difference** (6 years) always remains constant.

10 years ago, ratio of B : A = 3 : 4.

Difference in ratio units = 4 − 3 = 1 unit → 6 years.

A's age 10 years ago = 4 units = 4 × 6 = 24 years.

A's present age = 24 + 10 = 34 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 34 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Present age of A = **A**

Present age of B = **B**

A = B + 6 ⇒ B = A − 6

**Formula Used:**

Age 10 years ago = (Present Age − 10)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5656081c15335b48ecdd8994bb0f7ea5bf8eccc786f046c2b9f362617efb35e9.png] 

**Calculations:**

According to the question, 10 years ago:

⇒ B − 10 = 3/4 × (A − 10)

Substitute B = A − 6:

⇒ (A − 6) − 10 = 3/4 × (A − 10)

⇒ A − 16 = 3/4 × (A − 10)

⇒ 4 × (A − 16) = 3 × (A − 10)

⇒ 4A − 64 = 3A − 30

⇒ 4A − 3A = 64 − 30

⇒ A = 34

**∴ The correct answer is 34 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Constant Age Difference

The numerical difference between the ages of two people remains the **same** throughout their lives, regardless of how many years pass.

Ratio of Ages

If the ratio of ages at time t₁ is x:y and the difference is D, then 1 unit of ratio = D ÷ |x−y|.
